y-m-59-11.thinking.1: Daidaita ƙarfin tabbaci da sabon bayani
y-m-59-11.title: Shin an warware ma’aunin gaba ɗaya ne saboda an sami mafita biyu?
y-m-59-11.goal: Sanin cewa mafita na iya ɓacewa yayin sauya ma’auni, sannan ka tantance yawan mafita ta kwatanta hanyoyi daban-daban da ba sa rasa mafita a cikin tazara.
y-m-59-11.material:
Kana son nemo mafitar sin x=sin 2x ga 0≤x≤2π (an haɗa iyakoki biyu; ana ƙirga x a matsayin lambobi gaske daban-daban). (Karatu: sine x daidai sine 2x.) Jimin ta warware haka:

“Raba ɓangarorin biyu da sin x, sai a samu 1=2 cos x, wato cos x=1/2. Ga 0≤x≤2π, x da ke sa cos x=1/2 su ne π/3 da 5π/3; saboda haka mafita biyu ne.”
y-m-59-11.prereq.0: “H2” alamar wahala da tallafi ce kawai ga wannan rukuni da aka samar; ba ya nuna cewa Ma’aikatar Ilimi ta sanya darasin a wani aji. Ana ɗauka ɗalibi ya riga ya koyi abubuwan da ke ƙasa.
y-m-59-11.prereq.1: Ƙimomi da jadawalin ayyukan trigonometry (sin, cos ga 0≤x≤2π).
y-m-59-11.prereq.2: Ƙa’idar kusurwar ninki biyu sin 2x=2 sin x cos x.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane lokaci, zaɓi tunaninka game da mafitar Jimin.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.hint.0: Saka sabon bayanin kowane mataki kai tsaye cikin asalin ma’aunin sin x=sin 2x.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo ƙimomi a tazarar inda lambar da ake rabawa da ita za ta iya zama 0.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.info: Mafitar Jimin tana sama. Idan aka saka mafita biyu π/3 da 5π/3 cikin asalin ma’auni, suna tabbata da gaske.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yaya za ka tantance ƙarshen Jimin “mafita biyu ne daidai”?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.after: Mun tabbatar cewa mafita biyun sun tabbata, amma tun da an raba ɓangarorin biyu da sin x, ba a bincika ko wasu mafita sun ɓace ba tukuna.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Daidai ne. Ta raba ta warware, mafita biyun sun tabbata, saboda haka mafita biyu ne daidai.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka ɗauki tabbacin mafita biyun a matsayin tabbacin ƙarshen magana “babu wata dabam”. Nemo mafita da ta tabbata ya bambanta da nemo dukkan mafita.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Mafita ƙasa da biyu ne. Guda ɗaya ce kawai daidai.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.b: An bayar cewa mafita biyun sun tabbata. Wannan ya saɓa wa bayanin da aka bayar.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Mafita da aka samo daidai ne, amma akwai yiwuwar an rasa wasu mafita, saboda haka ana bukatar dubawa.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka bambance tabbatuwar mafita da “an samo dukkan mafita”. Wannan hali ne na bincika ko wani abu ya sauya yayin canza ma’auni.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba za mu iya sani ba sai mun ƙidaya maki haɗuwa kai tsaye a jadawali.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ka ba da shawarar hanyar dubawa kai tsaye maimakon yin ikirari daga mafita kaɗai. Ka yi tunanin ko za a iya bincika da hanyar algebra ma.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.info: Sabon bayani: idan aka saka x=0 a asalin ma’auni, sin 0=0 kuma sin 0=0; saboda haka ya tabbata. Idan aka saka x=π, sin π=0 kuma sin 2π=0; shi ma ya tabbata.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ta yaya hukuncinka game da mafitar Jimin ke sauyawa da wannan bayani?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.after: x=0 da x=π suna cika asalin ma’auni, saboda haka mafita ne. Domin raba ɓangarorin biyu da sin x, ana bukatar sin x≠0; amma ba a halatta rabawa ga x inda sin x=0 (0, π, 2π), saboda haka dole a binciki wannan shari’ar dabam.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.a: x=0 da x=π sun tabbata bisa sa’a, saboda haka ba sai an ƙirga su a matsayin mafita ba.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Idan ya tabbata bayan an saka shi cikin asalin ma’auni, mafita ne. Ka yi tunanin ko akwai mizani na cire mafita a matsayin ta faru bisa sa’a.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Mafita biyu na Jimin ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Sabon bayanin shi ne akwai wasu mafita, ba cewa mafitar Jimin ba daidai ba ce ba.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ƙarshen Jimin ba daidai ba ne. Da alama mafitar da sin x=0 ke bayarwa sun ɓace yayin rabawa.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka danganta dalilin da ya sa mafita kan ɓace yayin rabawa. Ka gyara hukuncinka bisa sabon bayani da ka tabbatar ta saka ƙimomin da suka cika.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ko da an sami sababbin mafita, ƙarshewar Jimin har yanzu daidai ne.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ba ka bincika ko sabon bayani ya girgiza ra’ayin cewa ‘biyu ne kawai’ ba. Sake ƙirga adadin mafita.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.info: Sabon bayani: sin x − sin 2x = sin x − 2 sin x cos x = sin x (1 − 2 cos x). Domin wannan ya zama 0, dole ne ko dai sin x = 0 ko kuma 1 − 2 cos x = 0.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mafita nawa ne wannan ma’auni yake da su gaba ɗaya a 0 ≤ x ≤ 2π?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan sin x = 0, to x = 0, π, 2π; idan cos x = 1/2 kuma, to x = π/3, 5π/3. Babu ƙima da ta maimaitu, saboda haka jimillar su 5 ce. (Da ace tazarar 0 ≤ x < 2π ce, 2π zai fita, a samu 4.)
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ba ka ƙirga mafita na yanayin sin x = 0 ba, ko kuma kawai ka bi ƙarshewar Jimin. Nemo x ɗin da sin x = 0 a cikin tazarar.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.b: A nan an ƙirga ƙarshen tazara 0 da 2π a matsayin maki guda. Wannan aiki ya ce a ƙirga x a matsayin lambobin gaske dabam-dabam.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wataƙila ka ƙirga wasu mafita sau biyu. Jera mafita na kowane yanayi ɗaya bayan ɗaya a cikin tazarar, ka duba ko akwai ƙimomin da suka zo iri ɗaya.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka haɗa mafita na sin x = 0 (0, π, 2π) da na cos x = 1/2 (π/3, 5π/3). Ka raba yanayin zuwa sassa kuma ka ƙirga kowanne dabam.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.reflect: Da farko, yaya ka yanke hukunci lokacin da ka ga ‘duka mafita sun cika’, kuma me ya canza bayan ka ga sabon bayani? Ta yaya ‘mafitar da aka samo daidai ce’ ta bambanta da ‘an samo dukkan mafita’?
y-m-59-11.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk hanyoyin da za a iya amfani da su domin kada a rasa mafita a cikin tazara.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.hint.0: Gwada da kanka adadin mafitar da kowace hanya take bayarwa.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta ƙimomin da ya kamata ka bincika kafin raba.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.o.a: Kafin ka raba, bincika yanayin sin x = 0 dabam.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.a: Wannan hanya ce da ke bincika yanayin da adadin da za a raba da shi yake 0 dabam. Idan ka rasa wannan hanyar, yi tunanin abin da ya kamata ka bincika kafin raba.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.o.b: Matsar da komai gefe guda, warware zuwa abubuwan ninkawa, sannan ka raba yanayin inda samfurin yake 0.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.b: Wannan hanya tana warwarewa zuwa abubuwan ninkawa ba tare da raba ba kuma tana samun duka yanayin biyu. Idan ka rasa wannan hanyar, sake duba bayanin matakin da ya gabata.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.o.c: An samu mafita biyu, saboda haka ka ɗauka sun isa ka kuma gama maganin nan take.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.c: Ka yanke cewa an gama ne bisa adadin mafitar da aka samo. Samun mafitar da ta cika ya bambanta da samun dukkan mafita.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.o.d: Zana jadawalin ayyukan biyu, sannan ka ƙirga wuraren da suka haɗu.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.d: Wannan hanya ce da ke bincika mafita ta wuraren haɗuwar jadawali maimakon lissafin algebra. Idan ka rasa wannan hanyar, yi tunanin yadda mafitar ma’auni take a jadawali.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.o.e: Raba ɓangarorin biyu da sin x ka warware, sannan ka ƙara x = 0 a matsayin mafitar da aka rasa kawai.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.e: Ka gyara wasu daga cikin mafitar da aka rasa kawai. Nemo duk x ɗin da sin x = 0 a cikin tazarar.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.explain: Bincika dabam maki inda mafita za su ɓace (sin x = 0) (a), matsar da ƙaluma ka warware zuwa abubuwan ninkawa (b), da ƙirga haɗuwar jadawali (d); duk hanyoyi ne masu inganci. Hanyar c ba ta bincika ko an samo dukkan mafita ba, yayin da e ta rasa π da 2π ban da 0.
y-m-59-11.s.s3.prompt: Taƙaita cikin jumla ɗaya ko biyu ‘abin lura yayin raba ɓangarorin biyu da wani furuci’, sannan ka ba da ma’auni guda dabam da sin x = sin 2x a matsayin misali.
y-m-59-11.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta abin da zai faru idan ka saka cikin ainihin ma’aunin ƙimomin da ke sa furucin da kake son rabawa da shi ya zama 0.
y-m-59-11.s.s3.hint.1: Ƙirƙiri ma’auni mafi sauƙi mai tsari makamanci (kamar x(x − 1) = x).
y-m-59-11.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan aka raba ɓangarorin biyu da ..., ...
y-m-59-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta cewa dole ne a bincika ‘ƙimomin da ke sa furucin da za ka raba da shi ya zama 0’ kafin rabawa?
y-m-59-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka tabbatar misalinka da gaske ma’auni ne inda rabawa ke rasa mafita (misali, x(x−1) = x)?
y-m-59-11.s.s3.model.0: Lokacin raba ɓangarorin biyu da wani furuci, ƙimomin da ke sa furucin ya zama 0 na iya zama mafita, saboda haka dole ne a bincike su dabam; ko kuma kada a raba, a matsar da komai gefe guda a warware zuwa abubuwan ninkawa. Misali, a x(x−1) = x, idan ka raba ɓangarorin biyu da x, za ka rasa mafita x = 0.
y-m-59-11.s.s3.model.1: Idan furucin da za ka raba da shi zai iya zama 0, dole ne ka bincika wannan yanayin domin kada ka rasa mafita. Misali, a (x−2)(x+1) = (x−2)·3, raba da x−2 yana rasa x = 2; saboda haka ya fi aminci a matsar da ƙaluma a warware zuwa abubuwan ninkawa.

y-m-59-08.title: Shin dabarar jimla daidai ce da gaske kawai domin ta yi daidai lokacin n = 1?
y-m-59-08.topic: Jimloli ta amfani da ƙa’idojin sigma (alamar tara jimla)
y-m-59-08.goal: A mafita da ta yi amfani da siffofin sigma, nemo layin da bai kula da jimillar sashe na dindindin ba; bambance ƙima (n=1) inda furuci marar daidai ya yi kama da daidai bisa sa’a da ƙimar da ke bayyana kuskure, sannan ka inganta hanyar dubawa.
y-m-59-08.material: Hayun ta rubuta ƙimar Σ_{k=1}^{n}(2k+1) a matsayin furuci mai n. (Karatu: sigma, k daga 1 zuwa n, 2k da 1. Wato jimillar 3+5+7+…+(2n+1).) A ƙarshen mafita Hayun ta rubuta, “Na saka n=1, kuma ya ba da 3, jimillar da na samo kai tsaye, saboda haka daidai ne.”
y-m-59-08.thinking.0: Nemo layin da ke da kuskure a mafita.
y-m-59-08.thinking.1: Zaɓi ƙimar gwaji (misalin karyatawa) da ke nuna kuskure.
y-m-59-08.prereq.1: Ma’anar alamar jimilla Σ: Σ_{k=1}^{n} a_k=a₁+a₂+…+aₙ.
y-m-59-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko marar daidai a mafitar Hayun.
y-m-59-08.s.s1.hint.0: Haɗa kibiyoyi domin nuna yadda kowane layi ya samo asali daga layin da ya gabace shi.
y-m-59-08.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta jimillar da Σ_{k=1}^{n}1 ke haɗawa idan n=3.
y-m-59-08.s.s1.line.4: Idan n=1, to 1+1+1=3, wanda ya yi daidai da jimillar 3 da aka samo kai tsaye; saboda haka daidai ne.
y-m-59-08.s.s1.explain: A layi na 2, Σ_{k=1}^{n}1 yana nufin an haɗa 1 sau n, saboda haka ya kamata ya zama n, amma an rubuta 1. Layi na 1 (siffar sigma) daidai ne. Layuka na 3 da 4 sun ɗauko kuskuren layi na 2 yadda yake. Gwajin layi na 5 ya yi daidai bisa sa’a idan n=1, saboda haka bai nuna kuskuren ba.
y-m-59-08.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ƙimomin n guda 3 (lambobin halitta) inda furucin ƙarshe na Hayun n²+n+1 ya bambanta da “jimillar da aka samo ta haɗawa kai tsaye”. Wato ƙimomin da ba su yi daidai bisa sa’a kamar n=1 ba.
y-m-59-08.s.s2.hint.0: Idan n=2, kwatanta jimillar 3+5 da aka haɗa kai tsaye da n²+n+1.
y-m-59-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tsara a tebur yadda ƙimomin biyun suka bambanta idan n=1 da sauran n.

y-m-59-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Furucin Hayun n²+n+1 ya bambanta da jimillar da aka samo kai tsaye.
y-m-59-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Nemo jimillar 3+5+…+(2n+1) ta haɗawa kai tsaye da n²+n+1, sannan ka kwatanta su.
y-m-59-08.s.s2.explain: Ta haɗawa kai tsaye idan n=2 ana samun 3+5=8, amma furucin Hayun yana ba da 4+2+1=7. Idan n=3, jimilla 3+5+7=15 ce, furucin kuma 13 ne. Furucin daidai shi ne n²+2n, kuma n=1 ne kaɗai ƙimomin furucen biyun suka yi daidai.

y-m-59-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta takamaiman yadda za a zaɓi ƙimomin gwaji (ƙimomi da dama, a kwatanta da jimillar da aka haɗa kai tsaye)?
y-m-59-08.s.s3.model.0: Idan n=1, furuci marar daidai n²+n+1 ma yana ba da 3, saboda haka ya yi kama da daidai bisa sa’a. Idan aka saka n=2, jimillar kai tsaye 8 ce amma furucin yana ba da 7, kuskuren ya bayyana. Ya kamata a gwada da ƙimomi biyu ko uku daban-daban.
y-m-59-08.s.s3.model.1: Furuci daidai da marar daidai suna da ƙima iri ɗaya idan n=1, saboda haka ƙima guda ɗaya ba za ta bambance su ba. Zaɓi n da dama ka kwatanta da jimillar da aka haɗa kai tsaye, kamar 2 da 3, sannan ka duba ko duk sun yi daidai.

y-m-59-13.title: Idan ƙimar logarithm ta fi girma, shin abin da aka saka a ciki ma ya fi girma?
y-m-59-13.topic: Rashin daidaiton logarithm da kewayon tushe
y-m-59-13.goal: Tabbatar ta hanyar gwada yanayi cewa kwatanta girman logarithm ya dogara da kewayon tushe, bayyana sharadin da maganar ‘idan ƙimar logarithm ta fi girma, x ma ya fi girma’ take cika, sannan ka ƙirƙiri misalai na yanayin biyun da kanka.
y-m-59-13.material:
Jaehee ya ce, “Idan log_a x > log_a 3, to x > 3.” (Karatu: idan logarithm na x mai tushe a ya fi logarithm na 3 mai tushe a.) Tushen a yana cika a > 0, a ≠ 1, abin da aka saka x kuma yana cika x > 0.

Jadawalin yana nuna wasu ƙimomi.
Tushe 2: log_2 1 = 0, log_2 2 = 1, log_2 4 = 2, log_2 3 ≈ 1.58
Tushe 1/2: log_(1/2) 1 = 0, log_(1/2) 2 = −1, log_(1/2) 4 = −2, log_(1/2) 3 ≈ −1.58

y-m-59-13.thinking.1: Raba zuwa yanayi bisa kewayon tushen

y-m-59-13.prereq.2: Siffofin jadawalin ayyukan logarithm (ƙaruwa, raguwa) idan tushe ya fi 1 da idan tushe bai kai 1 ba
y-m-59-13.prereq.3: Neman ƙimomi kamar log_2 4 = 2 da log_(1/2) 4 = −2
y-m-59-13.s.s1.prompt: Yi hukunci kan maganar Jaehui ta amfani da ƙimomin jadawalin. (Yi amfani da abin da za a iya karantawa daga jadawalin kawai a matsayin hujja.)
y-m-59-13.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta ƙimomin logarithm na abubuwan da aka saka iri ɗaya (misali, 2 da 3) idan tushe 2 ne da idan tushe 1/2 ne.
y-m-59-13.s.s1.hint.1: A kowace ginshiƙi biyu na jadawalin, bincika ko ƙimar tana ƙaruwa ko raguwa yayin da abin da aka saka yake ƙaruwa.
y-m-59-13.s.s1.o.a: Daidai ne. Dalili kuwa shi ne yayin da abin da aka saka cikin logarithm ya fi girma, ƙimarsa ma tana ƙaruwa koyaushe.
y-m-59-13.s.s1.r.a: Ka faɗaɗa yanayin tushe 2 kawai. Duba yadda ƙimar ke canzawa yayin da abin da aka saka yake ƙaruwa a ginshiƙin tushe 1/2.
y-m-59-13.s.s1.o.b: Ba daidai ba ne. A wannan rashin daidaito, x yana ƙasa da 3 koyaushe.
y-m-59-13.s.s1.r.b: Ka manta da ƙimar jadawalin tushe 2 (log_2 4 > log_2 3). Duba yanayin da x ya fi 3 ga tushe 2.
y-m-59-13.s.s1.o.c: Daidai ne idan tushe 2 ne, amma ba daidai ba idan tushe 1/2 ne.
y-m-59-13.s.s1.r.c: Ka kwatanta yanayi biyu masu tushe dabam-dabam, ka yanke cewa ana bukatar sharadi. Aiki na gaba shi ne tsara ƙarshe da ke fitowa ga kowane tushe.
y-m-59-13.s.s1.o.d: Sanin ƙimar x ya isa; tushen ba shi da alaƙa da hukuncin.
y-m-59-13.s.s1.r.d: Duba yanayin da tushe dabam-dabam ke sauya alkiblar alamar rashin daidaito ko da x iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-59-13.s.s1.explain: A tushe 2, log_2 4 > log_2 3 kuma 4 > 3, wanda ya dace da maganar. A tushe 1/2, log_(1/2) 2 = −1 > log_(1/2) 3 ≈ −1.58 amma 2 < 3, saboda haka maganar ba ta cika ba. Don haka ya dogara da tushe.
y-m-59-13.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri nau’i biyu dabam-dabam na (a, x) waɗanda suka cika rashin daidaito log_a x > log_a 3, ta yadda misali ɗaya yake da x > 3, ɗayan kuma x < 3. (a > 0, a ≠ 1, x > 0)
y-m-59-13.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi tushe, nemo ƙimomin logarithm biyu, sannan ka duba wacce ta fi girma.

Ko da wace alama ma’aunin gama-gari yake da ita, r² tabbatacce ne, saboda haka alamar a₃ iri ɗaya ce da ta abu na farko.

y-m-59-04.title: Idan pH ya tashi daga 3 zuwa 6, acidity ya yi rauni sau nawa?
y-m-59-04.goal: Karanta daga bayanai yadda bambancin lamba guda a sikelin logarithm ke juya zuwa “sau nawa”, sannan ka ƙaryata ikirarin da ya yi kuskuren ɗaukar rabon lambobin sikelin a matsayin rabon yawan ƙwayoyi.
y-m-59-04.material:
Mu koyi pH, wanda ke nuna ƙarfin acidity. A wannan aikin mun yarda cewa a maganin ruwa mai rauni, yawan ion hydrogen [H⁺] (naúrar mol/L, “moles ga kowace lita”) ana kayyade shi da [H⁺]=10^(−pH). (Karatu: 10 ƙarfin mara kyau pH.)

Magani | pH | [H⁺] (mol/L)
A | 3 | 0.001
B | 4 | 0.0001
C | 6 | 0.000001

Donghyun ya ce, “pH na C ninki 2 ne na pH na A, saboda haka acidity na C ya fi rauni ninki 2 na A.”
y-m-59-04.thinking.0: Fassara alaƙar ƙimar sikelin da ainihin adadi.
y-m-59-04.thinking.1: Kai da kanka ka samar da nau’i-nau’in ƙimomi da suka cika sharadi, sannan ka gwada su.
y-m-59-04.thinking.2: Ƙaryata fassara marar daidai da shaida.
y-m-59-04.prereq.1: Lissafi da ƙarfi da ƙarfin lamba cikakkiya mara kyau (10^(−3)=0.001).
y-m-59-04.prereq.2: Ma’anar logarithm: pH=−log[H⁺] ⇔ [H⁺]=10^(−pH) (an bayar a matsayin yarjejeniya a aikin).
y-m-59-04.s.s1.prompt: Ka zaɓi duk jimlolin daidai bisa ƙimomin tebur.
y-m-59-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta ƙimomin [H⁺] biyu a tebur, sannan ka nemo sau nawa ɗaya yake na ɗayan.
y-m-59-04.s.s1.hint.1: Lissafta ko ƙimar bambancin A da B iri ɗaya ce da bambancin B da maganin pH 5.
y-m-59-04.s.s1.o.a: [H⁺] na C rabin [H⁺] na A ne.
y-m-59-04.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauki rabon ƙimomin pH (6:3) a matsayin rabon yawan ƙwayoyi. Raba ƙimomin [H⁺] biyu kai tsaye a tebur (0.001, 0.000001) ka kwatanta.
y-m-59-04.s.s1.o.b: [H⁺] na A ninki 10 ne na [H⁺] na B.
y-m-59-04.s.s1.r.b: Ka raba ƙimomin tebur 0.001 da 0.0001 domin nemo rabonsu. Ka karanta alaƙar idan pH ya bambanta da 1.
y-m-59-04.s.s1.o.c: A duk lokacin da pH ya ƙaru da 1, [H⁺] yana raguwa da 0.0009.
y-m-59-04.s.s1.r.c: Ka gamaɗa bambancin da aka gani daga A zuwa B (0.0009). Nemo ƙimomi domin duba ko shi ma yana raguwa da adadi iri ɗaya daga B zuwa pH 5.
y-m-59-04.s.s1.o.d: [H⁺] na A ninki 1000 ne na [H⁺] na C.
y-m-59-04.s.s1.r.d: Ka nemo rabon ƙimomin 0.001 da 0.000001 kai tsaye a tebur. Ka karanta sau nawa bambancin pH 3 ke wakilta.
y-m-59-04.s.s1.explain: 0.001÷0.0001=10, kuma 0.001÷0.000001=1000. Idan pH ya ƙaru da 1, [H⁺] ya zama kashi ɗaya cikin goma; idan ya ƙaru da 3, ya zama kashi ɗaya cikin dubu. Ba ya cire adadi iri ɗaya; rabonsa ne ke raguwa a kai a kai.
y-m-59-04.s.s2.prompt: Kana son zaɓar ƙimomin pH domin [H⁺] na magunguna biyu ya bambanta da ninki 1000 daidai. Ka ce pH na magani mai yawan ƙwayoyi shi ne p, na wanda ya fi rauni kuma q (0≤p, q≤14), sannan ka samar da nau’i-nau’i uku daban-daban na (p, q) inda [H⁺] na maganin pH p ya ninka na pH q da 1000 daidai. (pH ba lallai lamba cikakkiya ba ce. Idan p ya bambanta, misali daban ne.)
y-m-59-04.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta [H⁺] na magungunan biyu a matsayin 10^(−p) da 10^(−q), sannan ka rubuta furucin da ke kwatanta su.
y-m-59-04.s.s2.hint.1: Da farko zaɓi p guda, sannan ka canza q ka duba ko rabon ya zama 1000.
y-m-59-04.s.s2.var.p: pH na ruwan da ya fi ƙarfi p
y-m-59-04.s.s2.var.q: pH na ruwan da ya fi rauni q
y-m-59-04.s.s2.fail.c1: A ɗauka pH ya kai aƙalla 0 kuma bai wuce 14 ba.
y-m-59-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Nemo yawan sinadaran da ke cikin ruwan biyu ta amfani da [H⁺] = 10^(−pH), sannan ka duba rabon idan ka raba su.
y-m-59-04.s.s2.explain: Idan bambancin p da q ya kai 3, rabon yawan sinadaran shi ne 10^3 = 1000. Misali, (1, 4), (2, 5), (3.5, 6.5) duk za su yiwu. Ko da pH na farko ya bambanta, muddin “bambancin 3 ne”, yawan ninkin iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-59-04.s.s3.prompt: Ka bayyana wa Donghyun, ta amfani da ƙimomin jadawalin a matsayin hujja, dalilin da ya sa ba ya zama ninki 2 mafi rauni lokacin da pH ya tashi daga 3 zuwa 6.
y-m-59-04.s.s3.hint.0: Kwatanta [H⁺] na A da na C a jadawalin.
y-m-59-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ka rubuta a jumla yadda [H⁺] ke canzawa idan pH ya ƙaru da mataki ɗaya.
y-m-59-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka tabbatar cewa adadin (sau nawa) da ka bayar ya fito daga ƙimomin jadawalin?
y-m-59-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta dabam cewa “rabon lambobin pH” da “rabon yawan sinadaran” ba iri ɗaya ba ne?
y-m-59-04.s.s3.model.0: A’a. Idan aka duba jadawalin, A yana da 0.001, C kuma 0.000001, saboda haka A ya ninka C sau 1000. Duk lokacin da pH ya ƙaru da 1, yawan sinadarin yana zama kashi ɗaya cikin goma; idan ya ƙaru da 3, ya zama 10×10×10=1000. Rabon lambobin ba rabon yawan sinadaran ba ne.
y-m-59-04.s.s3.model.1: Ba ya zama ninki 2 mafi rauni; yana zama ninki 1000 mafi rauni. Duk lokacin da pH ya ƙaru da mataki ɗaya, [H⁺] yana raguwa har ya zama 10 sau ƙarami; saboda haka matakai 3 suna nufin ninka sau 10 sau uku, wato sau 1000. Ya kamata ka duba bambancin ma’aunin ƙarfin, ba ka raba lambobin pH ba.

y-m-59-05.title: Za a iya bayyana tsayin wannan ƙafar Ferris da kalmomi biyu dabam?
y-m-59-05.topic: Tsara abubuwan da ke faruwa akai-akai ta amfani da jadawalin ayyukan trigonometry
y-m-59-05.goal: Lokacin rubuta tsayin da ke motsi akai-akai da wata dabara mai siffar cosine, bincika yadda ake zaɓar tsakiyar tsayi, faɗin karkacewa da matsawa bisa ga sharuɗɗa, sannan ka ƙirƙiri dabaru biyu dabam-dabam (masu alamomi dabam) waɗanda suka cika sharuɗɗan.
y-m-59-05.material:
Ƙafar Ferris tana juyawa da sauri iri ɗaya, tana yin juyi guda cikin daƙiƙa 60. Mafi ƙasƙancin wuri yana da tsayin 2 m daga ƙasa, mafi tsayin wuri kuma 30 m ne. A ɗauka lokacin da fasinja ya hau shi ne t = 0 daƙiƙa, lokacin da yake a mafi ƙasƙancin wuri.

Ka tsara tsayin fasinjan (naúrar m) da h(t) = D + A·cos(2π(t − c)/60). (Karatu: cosine na 2 pi ninka t a cire c a raba da sittin) D shi ne tsayin tsakiyar motsin, A shi ne adadin da ke ƙayyade faɗin karkacewa (yana iya zama mara kyau), c kuma shi ne adadin da aka matsar zuwa dama (daƙiƙa). Ka taƙaita shi zuwa 0 ≤ c < 60.

y-m-59-05.prereq.1: Zagayowar lokaci, faɗin karkacewa da matsawar jadawalin mai siffar y = A cos(B(x − c)) + D
y-m-59-05.prereq.2: Ma’aunin radian: juyi guda cikakke = 2π (karatu: 2 pi) radian
y-m-59-05.s.s1.prompt: Me zai faru idan ka ƙayyade D da |A| daga mafi ƙarancin tsayi 2 da mafi girman tsayi 30?
y-m-59-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ka rubuta yadda dabara h(t) za ta kasance lokacin da ƙimar cos ta fi girma da lokacin da ta fi ƙanƙanta.
y-m-59-05.s.s1.hint.1: Warware ma’aunai biyu tare domin nemo D da |A|.
y-m-59-05.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauki mafi girman ƙimar a matsayin tsakiyar tsayi. Ka yi tunanin inda tsakiyar tsayin yake tsakanin mafi tsayi da mafi ƙasƙanci.
y-m-59-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka ɗauki mafi ƙanƙantar ƙimar a matsayin tsakiyar tsayi. Ƙimar cos tana tafiya daga −1 zuwa 1, saboda haka tana matsawa nisa iri ɗaya sama da ƙasa daga D.
y-m-59-05.s.s1.r.c: Ka musanya matsayin tsakiyar tsayi da faɗin karkacewa. Duba ko D + |A| da D − |A| sun zama 30 da 2.
y-m-59-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka sa tsakiyar tsayi a tsakiyar mafi girma da mafi ƙanƙanta, sannan faɗin karkacewar ya zama nisan daga wannan tsakiya zuwa ƙarshen. Idan ka duba D + |A| da D − |A|, za ka ga sun cika sharuɗɗan.
y-m-59-05.s.s1.explain: Mafi girman tsayi shi ne D + |A| = 30, mafi ƙanƙanta kuma D − |A| = 2; saboda haka D = 16 da |A| = 14.
y-m-59-05.s.s2.prompt: Ka ƙirƙiri (A, D, c) guda biyu dabam-dabam waɗanda za su sa fasinja ya kasance a mafi ƙasƙancin wuri (tsayin 2 m) a t = 0. (Zagayowar lokaci ita ce daƙiƙa 60, 0 ≤ c < 60, kuma a ɗauki c a matsayin cikakken lamba.)
y-m-59-05.s.s2.hint.0: Saka t = 0 a cikin dabarar, sannan ka rubuta ƙimar da ke cikin cos da ake buƙata domin h(0) ya zama 2.

y-m-59-05.s.s2.hint.2: Bayan ka zaɓi c, saka t = 0 da t = 30 ka duba ko tsayin ya zama 2 da 30.

y-m-59-05.s.s2.explain: Idan A = 14, to a t = 0 ƙimar da ke cikin cos dole ta zama −π (ko π) domin tsayin ya zama 16 − 14 = 2, saboda haka c = 30. Idan A = −14, to a t = 0 ƙimar da ke cikin cos dole ta zama 0 domin tsayin ya zama 16 − 14 = 2, saboda haka c = 0. Dabarun h(t) = 16 + 14cos(2π(t − 30)/60) da h(t) = 16 − 14cos(2πt/60) suna nuna motsi iri ɗaya.
y-m-59-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Ka rubuta a jumla ɗaya ko biyu dalilin da ya sa dabarun biyu suke nuna motsin wannan ƙafar Ferris iri ɗaya.

y-m-59-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka rubuta abin da ke faruwa da ƙimar cosine idan ƙimar da ke cikinsa ta canza da π.
y-m-59-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka duba ko dabarun biyu suna ba da tsayi iri ɗaya a lokaci guda (t = 0, t = 30)?
y-m-59-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana ta hanyar haɗa “alamomin sun bambanta” da “matsawar ta bambanta da daƙiƙa 30”?

y-m-59-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Dabarun biyu suna ba da tsayin 2 a t = 0 da tsayin 30 a t = 30, kuma zagayowar lokaci ita ce daƙiƙa 60 a duka. Ɗaya yana sauya alama, ɗayan kuma yana farawa bayan rabin juyi, saboda haka sakamakon iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-59-05.s.s3.prompt: Idan ka rubuta wannan ƙafar Ferris da sigar sine h(t) = 16 + 14·sin(2π(t − s)/60) (A = +14), menene s domin ta kasance a mafi ƙasƙancin wuri a t = 0? (0 ≤ s < 60)
y-m-59-05.s.s3.hint.0: Saka t = 0 ka rubuta ƙimar da ke cikin sin da ake buƙata domin tsayin ya zama 2.
y-m-59-05.s.s3.hint.1: Warware ma’auni domin nemo s da ke ba da wannan ƙima.
y-m-59-05.s.s3.r.a: A t = 0, sin 0 = 0, saboda haka tsayin shi ne 16 (tsakiyar tsayi). Ka yi tunanin ƙimar sin a mafi ƙasƙancin wuri.
y-m-59-05.s.s3.r.b: Ka zaɓi matsawar da za ta sa ƙimar da ke cikin sin ta zama −π/2 a t = 0. A wannan ƙimar sin = −1, saboda haka tsayin ya zama 2.
y-m-59-05.s.s3.r.c: Ka ɗauko matsawar da aka yi amfani da ita a sigar cosine. Ka duba cewa sine da cosine suna da tazarar kashi ɗaya bisa huɗu na zagayowar lokaci (daƙiƙa 15).
y-m-59-05.s.s3.r.d: Wannan ita ce matsawar sigar sine mai A = −14. Ka duba ko ƙimar sin a t = 0 ita ce −1 lokacin da A = +14.
y-m-59-05.s.s3.explain: Domin tsayin ya zama 2 a t = 0, ƙimar da ke cikin sin dole ta zama −π/2 (wato 2π(0 − s)/60 = −π/2). Saboda haka s = 15. Sine da cosine suna da tazarar kashi ɗaya bisa huɗu na zagayowar lokaci (daƙiƙa 15), saboda haka c = 30 na sigar cosine da s = 15 na sigar sine lambobi ne dabam-dabam.
